name: desk-t1985-s1-full-s4both
cmd: set -e; export RESEARCH_OUT={out} TMPDIR={out}/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR={out}/tmp/mpl WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_DIR={out}; mkdir -p {out}/desk {out}/tmp; {python} scripts/run_encoder.py desk; {python} research/exp/cache.py --out {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_full_s4both; {python} research/exp/epoch_variant.py --run {out} --overlay research/overlays/desk_tempho_1985_seed1_full_s4both.json --cache-out {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_full_s4both_late --work {out}/late
summarize: import json; s=json.load(open('{out}/desk/run_summary.json')); print({k: s.get(k) for k in ('best_epoch','epochs_run')})
